slug: 2025-08-07 Somalia expands national digital ID use cases to meet 15M issuance target by 2029

systems.tiers: launched in 2023 with World Bank support; required for passport applications from 1 September 2025 and domestic travel from 1 January 2026

note: Concerns use cases of the national ID only (passports, domestic travel, bank accounts); nothing is stated about civil registration.
